design: cross-sectional fixed developmental morphometry; ex vivo EdU and live imaging; computational fitting/comparison

randomized: false
blinded: false
data_excluded: false
sex: embryonic sexes not distinguished per authors
manual_reconstruction: manual tracing; no independent inter-rater accuracy estimate reported
source_statistics: retain original two-sided t-tests/P and R²; do not recompute or infer equivalence
derived_statistics: Figure2f per-sample means and across-3-sample mean±sampleSD explicitly extractor-derived
actual_effect_validation: not_performed
